description: This file defines the JMSConnectionHandlingActor class, which manages (connect/disconnect) operations for JMS connections and sessions within an Akka actor system. It handles session creation, connection management, consumer setup, and error handling for AMQP messaging using the Qpid JMS library.

classes.name: JMSConnectionHandlingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for managing JMS connection and session operations, including connect, disconnect, session recovery, consumer creation, and error handling for AMQP messaging.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for JMSConnectionHandlingActor with specified dependencies.

methods.name: propsWithOwnDispatcher
methods.description: Creates Props with specific dispatcher for blocking operations.

methods.name: getOwnDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the dedicated dispatcher for this actor from the ActorSystem.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling logic for different message types such as connect, disconnect, recover session, and create consumer.

methods.name: createMessageConsumer
methods.description: Creates a JMS message consumer for the given source if a session exists.

methods.name: handleCloseSession
methods.description: Closes the specified JMS session.

methods.name: handleRecoverSession
methods.description: Handles session recovery by closing previous session, creating new session and consumers, and notifying sender.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Attempts to establish a JMS connection and session, returning success or failure.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Closes the specified JMS connection and notifies sender.

methods.name: maybeConnectAndTell
methods.description: Attempts connection setup and sends success or failure message to the requester.

methods.name: tryConnect
methods.description: Creates and starts a new JMS connection and session, and creates consumers.

methods.name: startConnection
methods.description: Starts the JMS connection.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new JMS session with specific acknowledgment mode.

methods.name: safelyExecuteJmsOperation
methods.description: Executes JMS operations with error handling, rolling back connection if necessary.

methods.name: createConsumers
methods.description: Creates consumers for each source address, may throw ConnectionFailedException if any fail.

methods.name: createJmsConsumer
methods.description: Creates a JMS MessageConsumer for a specific source address, records failure if exception occurs.

methods.name: createJmsConnection
methods.description: Creates a new JmsConnection using the connection factory.

methods.name: buildConnectionFailedException
methods.description: Builds an exception object conveying which sources failed to connect during consumer creation.

methods.name: terminateConnection
methods.description: Stops and closes a JMS connection.

methods.name: disconnectAndTell
methods.description: Disconnects the JMS connection and notifies the sender.
